plain_summary_en: This paper studies News Frames and Online Political Hostility: Evidence from the 2022 South Korean Presidential Election. In plain terms, it asks what is happening, why it matters for public communication, and what evidence the authors use. The likely focus is Political science, Politics, Presidential election, Presidential system. The abstract suggests a mixed methods approach, which makes the work useful for understanding how communication changes in everyday life.
